title: Tell the owner about big POS sales and payments that did not go through
summary: The moment a Moniepoint terminal takes a sale above the amount you choose, or a payment is declined or reversed, tell the owner.
description: Whenever Moniepoint reports a transaction on one of your POS terminals, tells the owner at once if it is an approved sale at or above the amount you choose (so you know about the big ones wherever you are), or if the payment was declined, failed or reversed (so a customer is not let go with goods for a payment that never came). Everything else stays quiet. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem, or by email.

params.name: large_amount
params.title: Tell me about sales from (naira)
params.description: An approved sale at or above this amount is reported at once.

params.name: pos_connection
params.title: Moniepoint POS connection
params.description: The Moniepoint POS terminals connection whose transactions start this workflow.

definition.name: Big POS sales and declined payments
definition.description: Tells the owner about large approved sales and payments that did not go through.

steps.name: Read the sale from Moniepoint's report
Tell the owner about a big sale

input.title: Big POS sale
input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': ' + steps.prepare.output.row.kind + ' of NGN ' + string(steps.prepare.output.naira) + ' on terminal ' + steps.prepare.output.row.terminal + (steps.prepare.output.row.customer != '' ? ' from ' + steps.prepare.output.row.customer : '') + '.'

steps.name: Tell the owner about a payment that did not go through

input.title: POS payment did not go through
input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': a ' + steps.prepare.output.row.kind + ' of NGN ' + string(steps.prepare.output.naira) + ' on terminal ' + steps.prepare.output.row.terminal + ' was ' + steps.prepare.output.row.status + (steps.prepare.output.row.response != '' ? ' (' + steps.prepare.output.row.response + ')' : '') + '. Do not release goods for it.'
